name: Bluesky PDS
description: Host a federated Bluesky Personal Data Server (PDS) and manage accounts on your own domain. This deployment builds and runs the official TypeScript PDS directly in the LXC without Docker.

notes.text: Create A records for your PDS domain and its wildcard (*.your-domain) pointing to this LXC before installation.
TCP ports 80 and 443 must reach this LXC. They must not be in use by another service inside the container.
This is a source-built, community-maintained native deployment; it is not the upstream Docker installer and needs testing before production use.
